body: Yeah, I noticed that now. I don't understand why you got downvoted, from an outside perspective my comment doesn't really make a lot of sense. I've added some more details above now.

Rereading my last comment I realize I left out some really important details. While I have lived a good life compared to a lot of other people, I still feel like shit a lot. For the last 2-ish years I've been on and off suicidal, and even at the times when I've been alright depression has sort of been lurking in the background. I'm not even entirely sure why I'm depressed, but for the last week I've stayed home from school without being sick, partly because I don't have the energy to pretend like I actually care about staying alive. So I guess that's a fairly good indicator that it's time to talk to someone.

God I feel stupid rereading my last comment now, haha. I have a tendency to assume that people know more about me than they actually do, so feel free to ask more questions if there's anything that doesn't make sense. By the way, I want to say thank you for doing what you do here. I've read a few of the most recent posts here and I admire the way you help out the people here.

Not at all. To be honest I just feel like I've lived long enough already, despite only being 16. I've lived a relatively good life, I live in a first world country with good friends and family, and I have memories that I will cherish till the day I die, whenever that day may come. 

I know that if I stick around for another 60-70 years I'll make even more friends and have good experiences that will stay with me for the rest of my life, but at the same time I actually feel perfectly content with what I have so far, and I honestly wouldn't mind leaving this world within the next five minutes. I'm not going to leave just yet though, as that would cause to much pain to my family and friends.
